knobs.note: BH-9238: the trailing window of review_disprove_runs rows the report line counts. Read as ${REVIEW_DISPROVE_REPORT_WINDOW_D:-7}; a bad value falls back to 7 and the log line names it.
BH-9238: the weekday (date +%u, 1 = Monday) the report beat is posted; the files are written every day. --report-now posts on any day.

BH-9238: 1 = post the weekly report beat (a triaged fleet_alert, the route-shadow-report pass-through) when there is at least one BLOCK; 0 = write state/review-disprove-report/latest.txt and <date>.json only. --no-send wins.
BH-9238: next-read lookups per run (each one /api/verdicts read plus at most one GitHub compare read); fully disproved rows past it are counted 'not read (cap)'.
BH-9238: retention of state/review-disprove-report/<date>.json; the lane deletes files older than this each run (the rows themselves are kept by retention.review_disprove_runs.days).
BH-9238: the stop rule counts a fix-main-red or revert PR merged within this many days after the PR merged; candidates are read from the last 2 x this many days.
BH-9238: a fix PR hunk touches a disproved finding when it overlaps the finding's lines plus or minus this many lines (main moves after the review).
BH-9238: GitHub REST reads per run for the stop rule (PR, closed-PR list pages, file lists). Past it the run stops checking and the report line says truncated; the next daily run checks again.
